privacy.metaDescription: What data Vroom collects (account, scores, logs, cookies), why, who it is shared with, and how to exercise your rights under the LGPD.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Vroom (the "site") is a car guessing game maintained as a personal project by an individual ("controller", under Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD, Brazil's General Personal Data Protection Law). This document explains which personal data we process, under which legal bases, and how you can exercise your rights.
privacy.s1li1b: username, email, and password (stored only as a bcrypt hash) — or your Google identifier, if you sign in with Google.
privacy.s1li2b: scores, rounds played, and leaderboard presence (tied to the account; without an account they stay only in your browser via localStorage).
privacy.s1li3b: the hosting infrastructure records IP, date/time, and user-agent for security and rate limiting (anti-abuse).
privacy.s2li1b: creating and maintaining your game account.
privacy.s2li2b: security, fraud prevention, and rate limiting.
privacy.s2li3b: advertising and analytics cookies — opt-in, revocable.
privacy.s3p1: We do not sell data. We share only with: (a) the site's hosting and database provider; (b) Google LLC — OAuth authentication (when you choose Google login) and ad serving (Google AdSense), with international data transfer supported by the guarantees applicable to transfers under the LGPD (art. 33).
privacy.s4p1: Third parties, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits to this site or other sites. Google's and its partners' advertising cookies are only activated after your consent, and you can revoke it at any time on the cookies page.
privacy.s4p2a: You can turn off personalized advertising in the
privacy.s4p2b: , or learn about other opt-out choices at
privacy.s5p1: Account and game data are kept while the account exists (you can request deletion at any time). Technical logs are kept for up to 12 months.
privacy.s6p1a: You can request confirmation of processing, access to data, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion, consent revocation, and information about sharing. Just write to
privacy.s6p1b: — we reply within 15 days. If you believe your rights were violated, you can petition the ANPD (gov.br/anpd).
privacy.s7p1: As a small-scale agent (ANPD Board Resolution No. 2/2022), the controller is exempt from formally appointing a DPO, but keeps this channel open for data subjects: vroomfeedback@gmail.com.
privacy.s8p1: Vroom is not aimed at children. Those under 14 should only use it with authorization from their guardians, who can request data deletion through the same channel.
privacy.s9p1: This policy may be updated; the date at the top indicates the current version. Relevant changes (for example, new analytics tools) will be announced on the site and will require new consent where applicable.

cookiesPage.metaDescription: Which cookies Vroom uses (essential, advertising, analytics), why, and how to accept, reject, or review your preferences at any time.
cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.p1: Essential cookies (login session) do not require consent and cannot be disabled. All other categories are disabled by default and only activated with your explicit consent — the standard required by the LGPD and the ANPD cookie guide.
cookiesPage.essentialDescA: — login session (httpOnly JWT, 7 days, removed on sign-out).
cookiesPage.essentialDescC: — local scores and your cookie choice (localStorage, only in your browser).
cookiesPage.advertisingDesc1: Google AdSense and partner cookies to serve and measure ads (incl. personalization based on previous visits). Learn more on the
cookiesPage.analyticsDesc: Usage statistics to improve the game. No tool is active today; if one is added, it will be listed here and will require new consent.
cookiesPage.manageP1a: You can review your choice at any time — the banner shows up again and nothing is activated without your "yes". External alternatives: private browsing mode, your browser's cookie settings,
cookiesPage.manageP1d: . For visitors from the European Economic Area/United Kingdom, Google's certified consent platform (CMP) may display its own notice.
